zh: 这个不速之客是嘉定的周立春派来的。周立春与刘丽川有联系，所以上海一起事，周立春预备在嘉定响应，事先曾经跟尤五接头，希望“有福同享，有难同当”，尤五不愿这浑水，但也不便得罪他们，所以一直采取敷衍的态度。但以前可以敷衍，此刻到了真刀真枪要上场的时候，那就敷衍不过去了。“我来跟他说。”七姑奶奶小声诅咒着，话又难听了：“他娘的！只有强奸，没有逼赌！造反又不是去吃花酒，还有啥硬拉牢了一起走的？”“你又来了！”尤五嫂又气又急，“求求你，姑奶奶！你要跟他去吵架，还是不要去的好。”“唉！五嫂，你又看得我那样子草包了！我不过在这里发发牢骚，见了面，人家总是客人，我无缘无故得罪他做什么？”七姑奶奶推着她说：“你先去应酬应酬，要特别客气，不要冷落人家。”“不要紧。我开了早饭，请他在吃酒。”尤五嫂说：“人家是连夜赶来的。”“那么，你看他吃好了，请他在五哥的那间房子里见面。”
en: The unexpected visitor had been sent by Zhou Lichun of Jiading. Zhou was in touch with Liu Lichuan and intended to rise in Jiading as soon as the uprising began in Shanghai. He had approached You Laowu beforehand, proposing that they “share good fortune and face hardship together.” You had no desire to enter these troubled waters, yet could not afford to offend them, so he had always put them off with agreeable words. That had been possible before. Now that the time had come for real swords and spears, agreeable words were no longer enough. “I shall speak to him,” the Seventh Lady said, swearing under her breath in her usual coarse fashion. “Damn it! There is such a thing as forced sex, but not forced gambling. Rebellion is not an evening with singing girls. How can they drag someone along against his will?” “There you go again!” Mrs You was both angry and anxious. “Please, my dear lady! If you mean to quarrel with him, you had better not go.” “Oh, Fifth Sister-in-Law, you still take me for such a fool! I am only grumbling here. Once we meet, he is a guest. Why should I offend him without cause?” She urged Mrs You towards the door. “Go and attend to him first. Be especially courteous; do not leave him feeling neglected.” “There is no need to worry. I have had breakfast served, and he is drinking some wine. He travelled all night to get here.” “Then, when he has finished, ask him to meet me in Brother Five’s room.”

zh: 尤五有间密室，看是孤零零一座院落，四外隔绝，其实有地道与外间相通。七姑奶奶为怕走漏风声，特意约在那里相会。那个人是周立春的本家兄弟，排行第六，七姑奶奶也认识，但谈这些事，非另有凭信不可，因而一见面，她先这样问说：“周六哥，你要寻我五哥有啥话说呢？”周六略略踌躇了一下答道：“七姑奶奶，立春有几句机密话……”“慢点！周六哥，”她拦着他说，“既然是周大哥的机密话，你总晓得规矩？”“喔，我倒忘记掉了。”周六歉意的笑着，伸手到腰上去掏摸。他掏摸出来一块汉玉，送到七姑奶奶手里，这是信物。周立春因为造反是要杀头的机密大事，往来接洽，不便形诸笔墨，而派人传话，却又口说无凭，便与尤五作了个约定，用这块汉玉作为凭证。无此信物，守口如瓶，七姑奶奶知道有这样一个约定，所以首先就要查问。验明无误，她把汉玉交了回去，接着便说：“周六哥，你晓得我们这里情形的，你有话跟我说也一样。”
en: You had a private meeting room in what appeared to be an isolated courtyard, cut off on every side, though in fact a tunnel connected it with the outside. Fearing that word might leak out, the Seventh Lady deliberately chose this place for their conversation. The visitor was a clansman of Zhou Lichun’s, sixth in his generation, and she knew him too. But for business of this kind, personal acquaintance was not enough; credentials were required. As soon as they met, she asked, “Brother Zhou Liu, what is it you wish to discuss with Brother Five?” Zhou Liu hesitated. “Seventh Lady, Lichun has a few confidential words...” “A moment, Brother Zhou Liu.” She stopped him. “If they are Brother Zhou Lichun’s confidential words, you know the rule?” “Ah, I had forgotten.” With an apologetic smile, he reached into his waistband and produced a piece of Han-dynasty jade. This was his credential. Planning rebellion was a secret matter that could cost a man his head, so Zhou Lichun could not commit their dealings to writing. Yet a messenger’s unsupported word was no proof. He and You had therefore agreed that this jade would authenticate any message. Without it, lips must remain sealed. The Seventh Lady knew the arrangement and had asked for it at once. Having verified the piece, she returned it. “Brother Zhou Liu, you know how things are managed here. You may speak to me just as you would to my brother.”

zh: “是，是！我们也晓得七姑奶奶女中丈夫，令兄凡遇大事，都要跟你商量。”周六说到这里，不放心似的望外面看了一下，然后把声音放得极低：“上海方面的情形，七姑奶奶想必已有消息？”“我也是刚刚听说，详细情形还不晓得。”“上海已经成功了。刘大哥事情很顺手，以后还要顺手。苏州的绿营兵，湖州人居多，跟刘大哥是同乡，已经约定，就要起事。”周六顿了一下，很吃力地说：“立春也就要在这两三夭动手，以前跟尤五哥谈过，尤五答应到时候一定帮忙。我今天来，就是来谈这件事。”“喔，”七姑奶奶从从容容地答道：“你们谈过这件事，我是晓得的，不过我没有听我五哥说过一定帮忙的话。”这一下就谈不下去了，周六愣住在那里，一脸懊丧之色。
en: “Yes, yes. We know that the Seventh Lady has the mettle of a man and that your brother consults you in every important affair.” Zhou Liu glanced uneasily outside, then lowered his voice almost to a whisper. “You have heard the news from Shanghai, I suppose?” “Only just. I do not yet know the details.” “Shanghai has succeeded. Everything has gone smoothly for Brother Liu, and it will go more smoothly still. Most of the Green Standard soldiers at Suzhou are from Huzhou, his own home district. They have already agreed to rise. Lichun intends to act within the next two or three days.” Zhou paused, then continued with some difficulty. “He discussed it with Brother Five You before, and You promised to help when the time came. That is what I have come about.” “I know you discussed the matter,” she answered without haste. “But I never heard Brother Five promise that he would certainly help.” There was no obvious way to continue after that. Zhou sat dumbfounded, his face full of disappointment.

zh: “周六哥，我五哥最讲义气，为朋友上刀山、下油锅，他都肯的。是不是？”“是啊！”周六连连点头，“就为此，立春才来请尤五哥帮忙的，大家‘有福同享，有难同当’。”“实不相瞒，我五哥眼前就是难关。”七姑奶奶正好接住他的话，“如果是前一两年，我五哥有啥推辞是孙子王八蛋，眼前真正叫有心无力。为啥呢？为来为去为的是，不晓得哪个赃官想出来的，断命的‘海运’呀！”“海运？”周六问道：“是说漕米改海运？”“是啊，漕米改了海运，挑沙船帮发财！走关东的沙船，本来一向是装了压舱石头到北边的，现在改装漕米，平白里赚一笔水脚银子，运到天津不出事，还有啥‘保举’，沙船帮老大也做官了，气数不气数！”七姑奶奶咽了口唾沫，接下去又说：“沙船帮交贼运，我们漕帮要没饭吃了。松江是疲帮，你也晓得的，我五哥当这个家，真正是黄连当饭，苦头吃足。转眼重阳节边，西北风起，漕帮弟兄的夹衣裳都还在当铺里，我五哥不能不想办法。现在陪了个‘空子’到上海去做丝生意了，多少想掏摸几个，贴补贴补。周六哥你倒想想，我五哥在江湖上的身份，倘不是穷极无奈，怎么肯去服侍一个空子？这样子泥菩萨过江，自身难保的时候，怎么帮得上周大哥的忙？“
en: “Brother Zhou Liu, no one values loyalty more than my brother. For a friend, he would climb a mountain of blades or plunge into boiling oil. Would he not?” “Indeed!” Zhou nodded repeatedly. “That is why Lichun asked for his help. We should share good fortune and face hardship together.” “To tell you the truth, my brother is facing hardship himself at this very moment.” She seized the opening. “A year or two ago, if he had made excuses, he would have been a contemptible bastard. Now he truly has the will but not the means. Why? It all comes back to that damned sea transport, dreamed up by some corrupt official!” “Sea transport? You mean sending the grain tax by sea?” “Exactly. It fattens the purse of the Sand-Boat Guild. Their vessels used to sail north towards Manchuria carrying nothing but stone ballast. Now they carry tax rice instead and earn freight money for what was once an empty voyage. If they reach Tianjin without mishap, there are recommendations for official rewards as well. Even the guild leaders are becoming officials. Is that not enough to make one furious?” She swallowed and continued. “The sand-boat men are enjoying their cursed good fortune, while our Grain Transport Brotherhood is losing its livelihood. You know Songjiang is one of the impoverished branches. Keeping this household of men going has been like eating bitter coptis root instead of rice for my brother—nothing but hardship. The Double Ninth Festival will soon be here, and the northwest winds will rise, yet the brothers’ lined coats are still in the pawnshops. He has to find some means of helping them. At present he has gone to Shanghai with an outsider to trade in silk, hoping to scrape together something to fill the gaps. Think of his standing in our world, Brother Zhou Liu! Would he attend on an outsider unless poverty left him no choice? He is like a clay Buddha crossing a river, unable even to save himself. How can he help Brother Zhou Lichun?”

zh: 一番话说得周六哑口无言，好半天才说了句：“既然如此，尤五哥为啥又说，到时候一定帮忙。”“这就是我五哥的为人。你现在跟他去说，他还是会答应帮忙。不过这个忙，照我看，是越帮越忙。”“噢！”周六深为诧异，“这是啥道理？”“啥道理？吃饭的道理。”七姑奶奶答得极其爽脆，“漕米为啥改为海运，说运河水浅，有时候漕船不通，这好想办法，时世一乱，漕船走不过去，那才是死路一条。帮里的弟兄，对‘长毛’都摇头，现在再要他们跟周大哥一起走，表面不说，心里另有打算。万一做出啥对不起人的事来，我五哥一定压不住。这不是越帮越忙吗？”周六听她这一说，打了个寒噤。果然要松江漕帮协同起事，说不定洋枪到手，枪口朝里，那岂是儿戏之事？
en: Zhou was left speechless. After a long pause, he managed to ask, “Then why did he promise to help when the time came?” “That is the sort of man he is. Ask him now, and he will still promise. But in my opinion, the more he helped, the more trouble he would cause.” “Oh?” Zhou was astonished. “Why should that be?” “Because men have to eat.” Her answer was crisp. “Why was the grain tax diverted to the sea? They say the canal is too shallow and the grain boats sometimes cannot pass. One can find a remedy for that. But if disorder makes the route impassable, that is a complete dead end. The brothers already shake their heads at the Longhairs. Ask them to follow Brother Zhou Lichun now, and they may say nothing openly while thinking something quite different. If they did something disloyal, my brother could certainly not hold them down. Would his help not make matters worse?” Zhou shuddered. If the Songjiang brotherhood joined the rising and, once it had foreign guns in its hands, turned them on its supposed allies, that would be no laughing matter.

zh: 不过，仔细想一想也不对。俗称“通草”的“通漕”，周六也见过，上面记着，陆祖命翁、钱、潘三祖下山行道，行的就是“反清复明”的道，陆祖说的两首偈子，第一首中的“前人世界后人收”，就指的是光复大明江山，第二首中“日月巍巍照玉壶”，日月合成“明”字，“壶”字谐音“胡”，指的是清，也有反清复明的意思在内。那么，现在起事反清，漕帮弟兄何能倒戈？他是想到就是，而七姑奶奶报以轻蔑说：“周六哥，这些道理不晓得是啥辰光留下来的？‘皇帝不差饿兵’，饭都没得吃了，现在想大明江山，不好笑？”再说下去，依然无用。这一趟完全白来。周六想了想，只好这样说：“那么，七姑奶奶，我今天这番话，算是没有说，你也当作不曾听见过好了。”这话她懂，“尽管请放心！我哪里会做这种半吊子的事？如果周六哥，你今天跟我说的话，漏一个字到外面，你尽管来寻我们兄妹说话。”她接下来又极诚恳地说：“周六哥，害你白来一趟，我心里真正过意不去。不过事情明摆在那里，实在力不从心。请你回去跟周大哥说，这一次真对不起他，别处有用得着我们的地方，尽管吩咐。话再说回来，我们也有请周大哥照应的时候，‘行得春风有夏雨’，只要力量够得到，帮朋友就是帮自己。”
en: On reflection, however, the argument did not seem right to him. Zhou had seen the brotherhood’s canonical text, the Tongcao, whose title was colloquially written with the similar-sounding character for “grass” in place of “grain transport.” It recorded how Patriarch Lu sent the three patriarchs Weng, Qian, and Pan down from the mountain to spread the Way—the Way of overthrowing the Qing and restoring the Ming. Of the two verses spoken by Lu, the first contained the line “The later generation shall recover the world of those before,” referring to the recovery of the Ming realm. In the second, “Sun and moon shine high upon the jade vessel,” the written characters for sun and moon combined to make Ming, while the word for vessel, hu, sounded like the word for the northern peoples and referred to the Qing. That too implied overthrowing the Qing and restoring the Ming. How, then, could the brotherhood turn against a rising directed against the Qing? He voiced his thoughts, only to receive a scornful reply. “Brother Zhou Liu, who knows how long ago those doctrines were handed down? Even an emperor cannot send hungry soldiers to fight. With no food to eat, is it not ridiculous to dream of the Ming realm now?” There was no point in pursuing the matter. His journey had been wasted. After thinking for a moment, Zhou said, “Then let us regard everything I have said today as unsaid, Seventh Lady. You may treat it as something you never heard.” She understood. “Set your mind at rest. I would never be such a bungler. If a single word of what you have told me escapes, come and call my brother and me to account.” She continued with great sincerity. “I truly regret that you have made this journey for nothing. But the situation is plain: we cannot do what we would wish. Please tell Brother Zhou Lichun that we are sorry to fail him this time. If there is anything else in which we can be useful, he has only to ask. We too may need his protection one day. Send a spring breeze, and summer rain will follow. As long as it is within our power, helping a friend is helping ourselves.”

zh: 周六暗暗点头，都说这位七姑奶奶办事跟男子汉一样，果然名不虚传。这几句话还有打招呼的意思在内，事情不成，朋友要交，索性买买她的帐。“这就是七姑奶奶的话了！尽管请放心！嘉定过来青浦，青浦过来松江，过几天到了贵宝地，有‘老太爷’在，决不敢惊动的！”“周六哥，你这句话值钱了。我替松江老百姓，谢谢你！”说着，她学男人的样子，抱拳作了个揖。总算不伤和气，把周六送出后门，七姑奶奶心里不免得意，笑嘻嘻地回到后面，尤五嫂迎着她问道：“怎么说法？”“没事了！”她守着给周六的诺言，“详细情形也不必说，总而言之一句话，五哥的麻烦，我统统把它扫干净了！”
en: Zhou nodded inwardly. People said that the Seventh Lady conducted affairs as capably as any man, and her reputation was justified. Her last words also carried an appeal. Even if the business had failed, the friendship should be maintained; he might as well show her the consideration she sought. “Since that is what you say, Seventh Lady, you may be entirely reassured. From Jiading one comes to Qingpu, and from Qingpu to Songjiang. If we reach your district in a few days, with the Old Master here, we would never presume to cause a disturbance.” “Brother Zhou Liu, those words are worth something. I thank you on behalf of the people of Songjiang.” She clasped her hands and bowed in the manner of a man. Harmony had at least been preserved. After seeing Zhou out through the back door, she could not help feeling pleased with herself and returned to the rear quarters smiling. Mrs You came to meet her. “What was said?” “It is all settled.” She kept her promise to Zhou. “There is no need to go into the details. In a word, I have swept away every one of Brother Five’s difficulties.”

zh: “真正亏得你！”尤五嫂极欣慰他，“实在也要谢谢胡老板，不是他来，你五哥不会到上海去。叫他自己来应付，还不如你出面来得好。”“这话倒是真的。”七姑奶奶想了想说，“五嫂，我今天要到上海去一趟。”“应该去一趟。”尤五嫂说，“就怕路上不好走。”“怕什么？”七姑奶奶毫不在乎的，“他们闹事是在陆路上，我们坐船去，根本就碰不见，碰见也不要紧，凭我还会怕他们？”“那好，你就赶快去一趟，叫你五哥在那里躲一躲，省得那班‘神道’又来找麻烦。”“我晓得。我去收拾东西，五嫂，你关照他们，马上替我备船。”
en: “We are fortunate to have you!” Mrs You was deeply relieved. “We should thank Mr Hu too. Without him, your brother would never have gone to Shanghai. You have handled this better than he could have done himself.” “That is true.” After considering, the Seventh Lady said, “Fifth Sister-in-Law, I must go to Shanghai today.” “You ought to. I only fear the journey may be difficult.” “What is there to fear?” She was unconcerned. “They are making trouble on land. We shall go by boat and never encounter them. Even if we did, would I be afraid?” “Then go as soon as you can. Tell Brother Five to stay out of the way there for a while, so that those troublemakers do not come looking for him again.” “I understand. I shall pack. Please have a boat made ready at once.”

zh: 于是七姑奶奶回到自己卧室，匆匆收拾随身衣物，正在手忙脚乱的当儿，阿珠悄悄的走了进来，有所央告。“七姐！”她用耍赖的神态说道：“我不管，你一定要带我一起走。”“咦！”七姑奶奶有些诧异：“我又不是去玩儿。”“我也不是去玩儿。我要去看我爹，不然不放心。”“话是不错，走起来有难处，路上不平靖。”七姑奶奶郑重其事地说，“你想想看，造反的人，哪个不是无法无天？遇见了，不是好玩儿的。”“我不怕！”阿珠豁出去了，“大不了一条命。”“他不要你的命，要你的身子。”听这句话，阿珠不能不怕，愣了一会说：“那么你呢？”“我不要紧，跟他们‘滚钉板’，滚过明白。”七姑奶奶又说，“我再告诉你，我学过拳头，象阿龙这样的，三、五个人，我一样把他们‘摆平’！”说完，她拿起墙角的一枝青皮甘蔗，右掌平平的削过去，也不见她如何用力，甘蔗却已断成两截。这一说一试，效用恰好相反，阿珠对她本就信赖，现在看她“露了一手”，益发放心，轻松地笑道：“我有个女镖客保镖，还伯什么？我跟你走定了！我也会收拾东西。“
en: She returned to her bedroom and hurriedly gathered the clothes she would need. While she was busy, A’zhu slipped in with a request. “Seventh Sister, I do not care what you say—you must take me with you.” “Eh?” The Seventh Lady was surprised. “I am not going for an outing.” “Neither am I. I want to see Father. Otherwise I cannot feel easy.” “That is understandable, but the journey is difficult. The roads are unsettled.” She spoke gravely. “Think of it: what rebel has any respect for law or restraint? Meeting them would be no joke.” “I am not afraid!” A’zhu declared recklessly. “At worst, I have only one life to lose.” “They may spare your life and assault you instead.” That frightened her. After a pause, she asked, “What about you?” “I shall be all right. I can face them and settle things directly. Besides, I have trained in martial arts. Three or five fellows like A’long would be no match for me.” Taking a green sugar cane from the corner, she struck it with the edge of her right palm. She seemed to use scarcely any force, yet the cane broke in two. Her explanation and demonstration had exactly the opposite effect from the one intended. A’zhu already trusted her. Now, seeing this display of skill, she felt safer still. “With a woman bodyguard to protect me, what have I to fear?” she said lightly. “I am definitely coming. I shall pack too.”

zh: “慢点，慢点。”七姑奶奶一把拖住她，想了又想，无奈点头：“你一定要去，我就依你。不过，说实话，象你这样人又漂亮，年纪又轻的人，我带了你走，责任很重。你要听我的话做，不然……”“听，听！”阿珠抢着表示态度：“不管你怎么说，我都听。”“那么，”七姑奶奶说，“你也不是没有在江湖上走过的，总晓得女人有女人的笨法子。你有没有粗布衬裤？”阿珠也听人说过这种“笨法子”，很愿意试一试，但是，“精布裤子倒没有。“她说。“那就多穿两条。”阿珠依言而行，穿了三条衬裤，两件紧身小马甲，到了七姑奶奶那里，关紧房门，拿针线把裤腰裤脚和小马甲的前襟，缝得死死地。这样子，遭到强暴，对方就很难得逞了。
en: “A moment, a moment.” The Seventh Lady caught her and thought it over again. Finally, with a helpless nod, she yielded. “If you insist, I shall take you. But frankly, bringing someone as young and pretty as you places a heavy responsibility on me. You must do as I say, or else...” “I will, I will!” A’zhu interrupted eagerly. “Whatever you say, I shall do.” “Then you have travelled enough to know that women have their own crude precautions. Have you any undertrousers of coarse cloth?” A’zhu had heard of this precaution and was quite willing to try it, but she had no coarse-cloth pair. “Then wear several pairs.” She obeyed, putting on three pairs of undertrousers and two close-fitting little waistcoats. Back in the Seventh Lady’s room, with the door firmly shut, they sewed the waistbands, trouser cuffs, and waistcoat fronts securely shut. The intention was to make it difficult for an attacker to get through the clothing.

zh: 到了饭后，正预备下船，突然来了个意想不到的人，是陈世龙，一身泥泞、十分狼狈，但精神抖擞，脸上充满了经历艰险，安然到达目标的快慰。这一到，立刻为尤家的人所包围，都要听他从上海带来的消息。七姑奶奶和阿珠也就停了下来，先听他了，再定行止。“你是怎么来的？”尤五嫂急急问道，“我们的人都好的吧？”“都好，都好！”陈世龙大声答道：“都住在夷场，安稳得很。”有这句话，大家都放心了，“那么，上海县城呢？”尤五嫂又问。“县城失守了。”陈世龙所了解的情形，相当完整，于是从头细说，“小刀会要起事，早有谣言了，坏在吴道台手里……”
en: After lunch, just as they were preparing to board, an unexpected visitor arrived: Chen Shilong. He was covered in mud and looked thoroughly bedraggled, but his spirits were high. His face showed the satisfaction of a man who had come through danger and reached his destination safely. The household immediately gathered around him, all eager for news of Shanghai. The Seventh Lady and A’zhu postponed their departure; they would hear what he had to say before deciding what to do. “How did you get here?” Mrs You asked urgently. “Our people are all well, I hope?” “All well, all well!” Chen answered loudly. “They are staying in the foreign settlement. Perfectly safe.” This reassured everyone. “And the county town?” she asked. “The town has fallen.” Chen had a fairly complete understanding of events and began at the beginning. “There had long been rumours that the Small Swords Society intended to rise. The trouble lay with Circuit Intendant Wu...”

zh: 吴道台是指苏松太兵备道吴健彰。他跟刘丽川是同乡旧识，而上海县的团练又多是广东、福建人，因此，吴健彰对于小刀会利用团练起事的流言，不以为意，在他的想法，小刀会起事，就是跟他过不去，有彼此的交情在，刘丽川不会做出什么对不起人的事来。谁知刘丽川已经跟太平天国的丞相罗大纲有联络，同时与英国领事温那治有所联系，决定于“丁祭”那天起事，先攻县衙门。上海县知县名叫袁祖惪，是袁子才的孙子，由捐班的宝山县丞，升任上海知县。这天一早整肃衣冠，预备坐轿到文庙去上祭，人刚走出大堂，拥进来一群红巾裹头的人，为头的叫小金子，曾经为袁祖惪把他当流氓抓来办过罪，仇人相见，分外眼红，雪亮一把刀立刻递到胸前。袁祖惪倒也是个硬汉，破口大骂，不屈而死，吴健彰得到消息，溜到了英国领事署，总算逃出一条命。于是道署、县署、海关，相继被袭。小刀会占据了小南门乔家滨、沙船帮巨擘郁馥山新起的大宅作据点。城内乱得很厉害，但“红巾”不敢入夷场一步，因此难民纷纷趋避，十里夷场反倒格外热闹了。
en: He meant Wu Jianzhang, the military intendant of the Suzhou-Songjiang-Taicang circuit. Wu and Liu Lichuan came from the same province and were old acquaintances. Moreover, many of the Shanghai county militia were men from Guangdong and Fujian. Wu therefore paid little attention to rumours that the Small Swords Society would use the militia to launch a rising. In his view, such a rising would be an act against him personally. Given their friendship, Liu would never do anything so disloyal. Yet Liu had already made contact with Luo Dagang, a chief minister of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, and with the British consul, Wen Nazhi. He decided to rise on the day of the Confucian sacrifice and attack the county yamen first. Shanghai’s magistrate was Yuan Zude, a grandson of Yuan Zicai. Having purchased office as deputy magistrate of Baoshan, he had risen to the Shanghai magistracy. Early that morning he dressed formally and prepared to take his sedan to the Confucian temple for the sacrifice. He had just emerged from the main hall when a band of men with red cloths wound around their heads burst in. Their leader, Little Jin, had once been arrested and punished by Yuan as a hooligan. At the sight of his old enemy, his anger blazed; a bright blade was thrust towards Yuan’s chest. Yuan was a man of courage. He cursed them bitterly and died without yielding. On hearing the news, Wu fled to the British consulate and escaped with his life. The circuit offices, county offices, and customs house were attacked in succession. The Small Swords men established themselves in a newly built mansion belonging to Yu Fushan, a magnate of the Sand-Boat Guild, at Qiaojiabin near the Little South Gate. The city was in great disorder, but the Red Turbans dared not set foot in the foreign settlement. Refugees poured there for safety, making its ten-li extent busier than ever.

zh: “官兵呢？”七姑奶奶问道，“难道不打一打？”“官兵少得很，根本不敢打，带兵官是个守备，姓李，上吊死了。”“鸭屎臭！”七姑奶奶不屑地，“有得上吊，为啥不拚？”“不去管这些闲事了。”尤五嫂问，“你是怎么来的？”“我特地来送信，口信。”陈世龙看了看说，“可以不可以到里面去说？”这自是机密信息，引入内厅，陈世龙告诉尤五嫂说，尤五特地嘱咐，如果嘉定有人来，好好敷衍，千万不可得罪。“原来是这么一句话！”七姑奶奶问道，“怎么会叫你来的呢？”这话问得有理，尤五手下多的是人，传这样的信息，理当派自己人，何至于劳动来作客的陈世龙？
en: “What about the government troops?” the Seventh Lady asked. “Did they not even fight?” “There were very few of them. They did not dare fight at all. Their commander, a garrison officer surnamed Li, hanged himself.” “Duck dung!” she said contemptuously. “If he had the nerve to hang himself, why not fight?” “Let us leave these other people’s affairs alone,” Mrs You said. “How did you get here?” “I came specially with a message—a spoken message.” Chen looked around. “May we go inside to discuss it?” The information was plainly confidential. Once they had moved into the inner hall, he told Mrs You that You Laowu had particularly instructed them to deal courteously with anyone who came from Jiading and, above all, not to give offence. “So that is the message!” the Seventh Lady said. “Why did they send you?” It was a reasonable question. You had plenty of men of his own; a message of this kind should have been entrusted to one of them. Why trouble Chen, who was a guest?

zh: “其中有个道理，”陈世龙道，“胡先生叫我把珠小姐送回湖州，顺便就要我带个口信。”“这……”七姑奶奶深感意外，“这是为啥？”“胡先生说兵荒马乱，还是回去的好。张老板也是这么说。”“这要问问她自己。”七姑奶奶忽然又说，“这样吧，我们已经约好一起到上海，船都备好了，你跟我们一起走，有啥话到上海再说。“
en: “There is a reason,” Chen explained. “Mr Hu asked me to take Miss Zhu back to Huzhou. As I was coming this way, I was to bring the message too.” “But...” The Seventh Lady was greatly surprised. “Why is that?” “Mr Hu says that with war and disorder everywhere, she would be better off at home. Mr Zhang says the same.” “We must ask her.” Then she suddenly added, “Here is what we shall do. We have already arranged to go to Shanghai together, and the boat is ready. Come with us. Whatever needs discussing can be discussed when we get there.”

zh: “好的。啥时候走？”陈世龙看着身上说，“我一身烂污，总得先洗个澡。”等陈世龙到“混堂”里去洗澡的工夫，七姑奶奶才去找到因为他们要传机密口信而回避的阿珠，说了陈世龙此来的本意，以及她的决定，阿珠自然表示同意，但也不免奇怪，胡雪岩此刻正当用人之际，何以肯放陈世龙专程送她回湖州？七姑奶奶很快就看出，胡雪岩是在替陈世龙安排两人相处的机会。阿珠对自己的前途尚无着落，陈世龙又对她倾心，而且彼此已有些好感，漫长的旅程可能使两人的感情进一步发展。七姑奶奶却自觉比胡雪岩更了解他们，也有把握促成这桩婚事，因此自作主张，改变了他的安排。
en: “Very well. When do we leave?” Chen looked down at himself. “I am covered in mud. I must have a bath first.” While he was at the bathhouse, the Seventh Lady sought out A’zhu, who had withdrawn to let them discuss the confidential message. She explained the real purpose of Chen’s journey and her own decision. A’zhu naturally agreed, though she wondered why Hu, who must be badly in need of helpers just now, was willing to send Chen on a special journey to escort her home. The Seventh Lady was shrewd enough to understand at once that Hu was making an opportunity for Chen. A’zhu was uncertain of her future, Chen was deeply attached to her, and some affection had already grown between them. A long journey together might allow their feelings to develop further. Yet the Seventh Lady believed she understood the two better than Hu did and was confident that she could help bring about a suitable match. She therefore took it upon herself to change his arrangements.

adaptation.reason: 将涉及已知未成年角色的性暗示改为感情发展及婚事筹划的非露骨概述，保留七姑奶奶改变行程的动机。

zh: * * *舟入吴淞江，顺风顺水，一夜工夫就到了上海。船不敢再泊小东门，在洋泾滨上岸，直接坐轿到了裕记丝栈。丝栈里乱得一团糟，连走廊上都打着地铺，全是县城里和浦东一带逃难来的，沾亲带故，半央求、半强占地住了下来。七姑奶奶也是第一次到这里来，一看这情形就喊了起来：“这里怎么住法？五哥他们住哪里？”不要吵，不要吵！有地方。“陈世龙引着她和阿珠，径自走到最后，另有道黑漆石库门，虚虚掩着，推开一看，别有天地，三开间一楼一底，堆满了丝包。“咦！阿珠。”阿珠抬头一看，是她父亲正开了楼窗在喊。“楼下堆丝，楼上住人。”陈世龙告诉七姑奶奶说：“上楼再说。”老张下楼把他们接到楼上，父女相见，因为有了一番变乱的缘故，所以多少有恍如隔世之感。坐定下来，七姑奶奶问道：“他们呢？”这是指尤五和胡雪岩。“洋人请他们吃番菜，谈生意，大概快要回来了。”老张又问她女儿，“我跟雪岩商量，叫世龙送你回湖州，你怎么跑到上海来了。”“是我的主意。”七姑奶奶抢着答道，“好在也方便得很，闲话少说，张老板，对不起你，请你楼下坐一坐，我们要房间用一用。”
en: Their boat entered the Wusong River and, favoured by both wind and current, reached Shanghai after a single night. They dared not moor at the Little East Gate this time. Landing at Yangjingbang, they took sedan chairs directly to the Yuji Silk Warehouse. The place was in chaos. Even the corridors were covered with makeshift bedding. Refugees from the county town and the Pudong area, all connected with the household by some tie of kinship or acquaintance, had half begged and half forced their way into lodging there. It was the Seventh Lady’s first visit too. At the sight of the crowd, she cried, “How can anyone live here? Where are Brother Five and the others?” “Do not worry. There is room.” Chen led the two women straight to the back, where another black-painted, stone-framed gate stood slightly ajar. Beyond it was quite a different world: a two-storey building three bays wide, stacked with bales of silk. “A’zhu!” She looked up and saw her father calling from an open upstairs window. “The silk is downstairs; the people sleep above,” Chen explained. “Let us go up first.” Zhang came down to meet them and led them upstairs. After the upheaval they had endured, father and daughter felt almost as though they were meeting in another lifetime. When they were seated, the Seventh Lady asked, “Where are they?” She meant You and Hu. “Some foreigners have invited them to a Western meal to discuss business. They should be back soon.” Zhang turned to his daughter. “Xueyan and I agreed that Shilong should take you to Huzhou. Why have you come to Shanghai instead?” “It was my idea,” the Seventh Lady answered quickly. “It was easy enough to arrange. But let us say no more for now. Mr Zhang, forgive me, but would you sit downstairs for a little while? We need to use the room.”

zh: 这话真说到了阿珠心里，自从用了那个“笨法子”，大不“方便”，她连茶都不敢多吃一口，急于解除束缚，轻松一下，所以帮着七姑奶奶催：“爹，你先请下去，快，快！”老张莫名其妙，但女人的事也不必多问，提着旱烟袋就走，陈世龙自然也要下楼，指一指左右说：“两间房都开着，随便你们用哪一间。”“阿龙，”七姑奶奶喊住了他，从来不晓得什么叫难为情的人，这时也不免有些忸怩，窘笑着说：“拜托你一件事，也不晓得他们这里有没有娘姨，大厨房在哪里？替我们提一桶热水来，好不好？”“怎么不好？”陈世龙也很机警，“胡先生房间有个新买的脚盆，你们用好了。”说着，“噔、噔、噔”一直下楼。“你看，”七姑奶奶低声对阿珠笑道：“阿龙替你提洗脚水去了！”阿珠无心理她的戏谑，匆匆奔进房去。七姑奶奶自然也跟着行动，两个人的手脚都很快，关紧门窗，相互帮忙，在黑头里摸索着，解除了束缚。不久，楼梯声响，是陈世龙提了水上楼，一壶热水、一桶凉水，交代明白，便待下楼。
en: This was exactly what A’zhu wanted. Since taking that “crude precaution,” she had found the restrictions most inconvenient and had scarcely dared drink any tea. She was eager to undo the fastenings and be comfortable again. “Father, please go down for a little while,” she urged. “Quickly!” Zhang was puzzled, but saw no need to inquire into women’s matters. He took his tobacco pipe and left. Chen naturally had to go too. Pointing to either side, he said, “Both rooms are open. Use whichever you please.” “A’long!” The Seventh Lady called him back. For once, even this woman who scarcely knew the meaning of embarrassment looked a little awkward. She smiled sheepishly. “May I trouble you with something? I do not know whether they have a maid here, or where the main kitchen is. Could you bring us a bucket of hot water?” “Of course.” Chen understood quickly. “There is a newly bought washbasin in Mr Hu’s room. You may use it.” He hurried downstairs. “Look,” the Seventh Lady whispered teasingly to A’zhu. “A’long has gone to fetch your washing water.” A’zhu had no attention to spare for jokes and hurried into the room. The Seventh Lady followed. Both worked quickly: they closed the doors and windows, helped each other in the darkness, and undid the protective stitching. Before long they heard Chen on the stairs, bringing a kettle of hot water and a bucket of cold. Having explained which was which, he prepared to go down again.

zh: “阿龙慢一点！”七姑奶奶喊道：“黑咕隆咚的怎么办？要替我们拿盏灯来。”那间房正就是他跟老张的卧室，因而答道：“我桌上有洋蜡烛，还有包红头洋火，在我枕头下面。”“哪张床是你的？”“靠壁的那张。”陈世龙说“红头洋火，随便哪里一划就着，当心烧着手。”“晓得了！你不要走，我还有事情要你做。”
en: “A’long, wait!” the Seventh Lady called. “What are we to do in the dark? Bring us a light.” The room happened to be the one he shared with Old Zhang. “There is a foreign candle on my table and a packet of red-headed matches under my pillow,” he answered. “Which bed is yours?” “The one against the wall. The matches will light if you strike them anywhere. Be careful not to burn your hand.” “I understand. Do not go yet; there is something else I want you to do.”

zh: 七姑奶奶摸着洋火，取一根在地板上划亮。阿珠担心隔墙的缝隙让屋内失去隐私，立刻把火柴吹灭。七姑奶奶便问陈世龙在外面做什么。他说自己坐着等候，看她还有什么事要吩咐。她拿他守在外面打趣，又提醒他尊重她们的隐私。陈世龙笑笑没有回答，阿珠低声埋怨她不该特地提这件事，又请她别点蜡烛。陈世龙听见后，觉得还是守规矩要紧，便大声说没有事就先下楼。七姑奶奶也觉得应当让他回避，谢过他，并请他守着楼梯，别让旁人突然上来。有了他守候，两人可以放心。七姑奶奶到胡雪岩房里取来脚盆，提水进屋；两人洗漱后重新梳头、涂脂抹粉，换上干净衣服，才开门出来。
en: The Seventh Lady found the matches and struck one on the floor. A’zhu immediately blew it out, concerned that the gaps in the partition might compromise their privacy. The Seventh Lady called to Chen to ask what he was doing outside. “I am sitting here, waiting to see what else you need.” She teased him about lingering and told him to respect their privacy. He smiled without answering. A’zhu quietly reproached her for drawing attention to the matter and asked her not to light the candle. Chen heard this and decided that proper conduct mattered more than anything else. “If there is nothing more, I shall go downstairs,” he called. The Seventh Lady agreed that he should withdraw. “Thank you. Please watch the stairs and make sure nobody comes up unexpectedly.” With him guarding the staircase, they could feel secure. She fetched the washbasin from Hu’s room and brought in the water. After washing, they took out their grooming things, arranged their hair, put on their cosmetics, and changed into clean clothes. Only then did they open the door.

adaptation.reason: 对涉及已知未成年角色的身体暴露、偷窥戏谑和相关反应作非露骨改写，保留照明、隐私顾虑、守楼梯和洗漱后的情节。

zh: 巧得很，正好裕记丝栈的老板娘，听说有“堂客”到了，带了一个粗做娘姨和一个丫头赶来。七姑奶奶是认得她的，招呼一声“陈太太”，接着便替阿珠引见。等娘姨在楼上替她们收拾了残局，宾主坐定寒暄，问了问路上的情形，陈太太邀她们到家去住。七姑奶奶怕拘束不肯去，转身跟阿珠商量，她也不愿住陈太太家，便以见了她父亲，马上就要回湖州，不必费事作推托。七姑奶奶也就设词力辞，陈太太只得由她们。坐了一会，邀客到她家吃晚饭，七姑奶奶答应等他们兄妹见过面，谈完正事再赴约。于是等陈太太一走，陈世龙动手替她们设榻，老张和他搬到楼下，在丝包旁边安设床位。原来的房间里一张大床，一张小床，七姑奶奶占大床，阿珠用小床，而这张小床，正就是陈世龙原来所睡的。
en: By coincidence, the proprietor’s wife had just heard that women guests had arrived and came over with a maid for heavy work and a younger maid. The Seventh Lady knew her and greeted her as Mrs Chen, then introduced A’zhu. While the older maid put their upstairs room in order, host and guests settled down to exchange courtesies and discuss the journey. Mrs Chen invited them to stay at her own house. The Seventh Lady feared the restrictions of being a guest and did not wish to go. When she consulted A’zhu, the girl agreed and offered the excuse that, having seen her father, she would soon return to Huzhou, so there was no need to make further arrangements. The Seventh Lady added her own polite refusals, and Mrs Chen had to accept them. After sitting a while, she invited them to dinner. The Seventh Lady agreed to come once she had seen her brother and finished their business. When Mrs Chen left, Chen Shilong arranged the beds for them. He and Old Zhang moved downstairs and made sleeping places beside the bales of silk. Their former room contained a large bed and a small one. The Seventh Lady took the large bed; A’zhu had the small one, which had previously been Chen’s.

zh: 刚刚安置停当，胡雪岩和尤五回到了裕记丝栈。时地相异，感觉不同，胡雪岩固然神态自若，阿珠也还显得从容。七姑奶奶略略道了决定到上海来的缘由，随即向尤五使个眼色，示意避人密谈，尤五因为跟胡雪岩已到了共机密的程序，所以顺手把他一拉，一起来听七姑奶奶的报告。“嘉定的人，昨天早晨来过了……”她把经过情形，细说了一遍。“这样应付也好！”尤五欣慰的。默默在一旁听着的胡雪岩，不曾想到七姑奶奶，如此能干，不免刮目相看。她发觉了他的眼色，心里觉得很舒服，便笑着问了句：“小爷叔，你看我说错了话没有？”“当然不错！”胡雪岩转脸对尤五说：“这下了掉一件心事，我们在上海可以好好动一动脑筋。”尤五先不答他的话，向他妹子低声叮嘱：“阿七，我一时不能回去，家里实在放不下心，趁这一两天，路上还不要紧，你赶紧回去吧！”
en: The arrangements had barely been completed when Hu and You returned to the depot. A different time and place produced different feelings: Hu was composed as ever, and A’zhu too seemed at ease. The Seventh Lady briefly explained why she had decided to come to Shanghai, then signalled to her brother that she wanted a private conversation. You now shared confidential matters with Hu and drew him along to hear her report. “The man from Jiading came yesterday morning...” She gave a detailed account. “That was a good way to handle it,” You said, relieved. Listening quietly, Hu had not expected the Seventh Lady to be so capable and regarded her with new respect. She noticed his look and was pleased. “Young Uncle,” she asked with a smile, “do you think I said anything wrong?” “Certainly not!” Hu turned to You. “That removes one worry. Now we can give proper thought to our affairs in Shanghai.” Before replying to him, You spoke quietly to his sister. “A’qi, I cannot return just yet, and I am anxious about things at home. The route should still be passable for a day or two. You had better go back at once.”

zh: 七姑奶奶点点头，问起他们在上海的情形：“ 生意怎么样？”这活在尤五就无从置答了，只是微微叹口气，见得不甚顺手。“生意蛮好！”胡雪岩却持乐观的态度，“正在谈，就要谈出结果来了。”事实上不容易谈得出结果，胡雪岩扳持不卖，洋行方面因为小刀会起事的关系，是在观望之中，所以最大的两项“洋庄”货色，茶和丝都变成有行无市，混沌一团。尤五因为生意方面不大在行，而局势甚乱，自不免悲观，因而才叹气不答。“阿七，”尤五又说，“你明天就回去吧！”
en: She nodded, then asked about their affairs in Shanghai. “How is business?” You had no ready answer. He merely sighed faintly, showing that matters were not going smoothly. Hu, however, remained optimistic. “Very good. We are negotiating and should have a result soon.” In fact, agreement would not be easy. Hu was holding firm and refusing to sell, while the foreign firms were waiting to see what would happen after the Small Swords uprising. Tea and silk, the two largest items in the export trade, still had quoted prices but scarcely any transactions; the whole market was in confusion. You knew little about commerce and, with the political situation so unsettled, naturally felt pessimistic. That was why he had sighed instead of answering. “A’qi,” he repeated, “go back tomorrow.”

zh: “晓得了！”七姑奶奶不悦，“我会走的。不过张家妹子是我带到上海来的，总要把她作个交代。”“交代她爹就是了。”话是不错，但七姑奶奶一心要牵那条红线，巴不得当时就有个着落，这话又似乎不宜出口，因而沉默着。“七姐！”胡雪岩看出她的热心，安慰她说，“事情是一定会有个好好交代的，急也急不得。我想把她先送回湖州，叫世龙送了去，那也就算是有交代了。”“嗯，嗯。”七姑奶奶不置可否地，然后又说：“裕记老板娘，今天请我们一起去吃夜饭，也该走了。”“不行！”尤五摇头，“我们今天夜里约好一个要紧人在那里。你们去吧！”于是乍一相见，匆匆又别。尤五和胡雪岩不暇暖地，赶到一家“堂子”里去赴约会。
en: “I know!” the Seventh Lady replied with displeasure. “I shall go. But I brought our sister Zhang to Shanghai, and I must make some arrangement for her.” “Leave her in her father’s care.” That was reasonable, but the Seventh Lady was intent on tying the red thread of marriage and wanted a settlement at once. She could hardly say so openly and fell silent. Hu understood her enthusiasm. “Seventh Sister, there will certainly be a proper arrangement. It is no use hurrying. I mean to send her back to Huzhou with Shilong. That, too, would count as making provision for her.” “Mm, mm.” She committed herself to neither agreement nor disagreement. Then she said, “The proprietor’s wife has invited us all to dinner tonight. It is time to go.” “We cannot,” You replied, shaking his head. “We have arranged to meet an important man this evening. Go without us.” They had scarcely met before they parted again. Without even time to warm their seats, You and Hu hurried away to keep an appointment at a courtesan house.
